output.summary: Annual or biennial flowering plant native across parts of Europe, northern Africa and western Asia. It bears bright-purple flower heads guarded by tough, sharp yellow spines. In western Crete a local variety's leaves are eaten boiled, while southern Italian Arbëreshë communities boil and fry young whorls with other wild greens.
